howto.goalBody: Guess the mystery Pokémon in {n} tries (in Classic). Every guess shows how it compares with the answer.
howto.coreBody: 🟩 ✓ the answer has the same. 🟨 ≈ near or close. ▲▼ the answer is higher or lower. ⬛ ✕ no match.
howto.scoringBody: A solve scores {first} on the first guess, less {cost} for each guess after it, never below {min}. A miss scores 0.
howto.hintsBody: After your first guess you can tap to use a hint, at a cost in points.
howto.example: Guess the mystery Pokémon in {n} tries (in Classic). Every guess shows how it compares with the answer. Say you guess {guess} and the answer is {answer}:
howto.match: 🟩 ✓ Match: the answer has the same.
howto.near: 🟨 ≈ Near: the right type in the other slot, or close (dashed border, with an arrow): one generation or stage away, or a height or weight within 25%.
howto.higher: ▲▼ Higher or lower: the way to go, and not close.
howto.miss: ⬛ ✕ No match. Stage runs Baby, 1, 2, 3, and a Baby is never close.
howto.squirdle: Stats: Gen, Type 1, Type 2, Height and Weight; ✓ right, ▲▼ higher or lower (no close states), 🟨 the type in the other slot. Guesses scale with the generations: 5 for Gen 1 only, up to 9 for all nine (the daily).
howto.custom: Custom (practice and duels): pick 3 or more clue columns.
howto.dailyFormats: The daily comes in Classic and Stats: one puzzle each for everyone, each with its own streaks and stats. Practice games and duels add advanced settings: generations, 6, 8 or 10 guesses, hints on or off, strict (▲▼ only, no close states), a 3-minute or 60-second timer, and a legendaries-only pool.
howto.pointsBody: A solve scores {first} on the first guess, less {cost} for each guess after it, never below {min} ({last} on Classic's last), the same as a duel without its speed bonus. A miss scores 0.
howto.bonus: A harder board pays more: +{column}% for each clue column hidden and +{strict}% without close states, up to +{max}% (Stats: +{stats}%). It multiplies with the Pokédex level below.
howto.hintList: Hints are never automatic. After your first guess you can tap to use one: {list}. Each one used is marked on your result and your share.
howto.dex: The Pokédex beside the board is your notebook. Like Wordle's keyboard, it greys out every Pokémon your generation and type clues rule out. Tap a Pokémon to cross it off, or switch to Fill in to put it in the guess box.
howto.dexSetting: The Pokédex setting (Off, Notebook, Field Guide or Full; set it before your first guess; it stays for the game) is how much the Pokédex helps. Less help, more points:
howto.dexAfter: Your result and share show the level. Duels give both trainers the same one.
howto.hard: Hard mode (set it before your first guess): every guess must fit the generation and type clues so far, so no greyed-out Pokémon. Your share gets a *.
howto.streaks: Streaks: finish the daily, won or lost, to keep your 🔥 play streak. Every {every} days in a row earn a 🧊 freeze (up to {max}) that covers a missed day by itself.
howto.archive: The archive has every past Classic daily. Archive and practice games never count toward streaks or stats.
howto.keys: Keys: <k>/</k> jumps to the guess box, <k>↑</k> <k>↓</k> and <k>Enter</k> pick, <k>Esc</k> clears.

duelCard.heading: Head to head · Pokédle
duelCard.blurb: The same mystery Pokémon for both of you, {rounds} rounds of {minutes} minutes.
duelCard.info1: Fewer guesses and a quicker solve score more; hints cost points. You see your opponent's colours as they guess.
duelCard.info2: Send a friend the link, and pick the format, generations and settings in the lobby. Or find an opponent: matched duels use every generation and pair you with someone on the same format and Pokédex.
